opportunities.name: Cross-office meeting sync: time difference + holidays → email draft
opportunities.description: For a given pair of cities and a target month, look up the time offset in the timeanddate Time Zone Converter, check the second city's country holidays, then draft an email to ops summarizing the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com and go to Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Type city A in 'Add locations' and pick the matching suggestion
Type city B in 'Add locations' and pick the matching suggestion
Read the hour difference between the cities
Open Calendar > Holidays and choose city B's country
Note the holidays that fall in the target month
Open a new message, set To = ops@example.com
Set Subject = 'Sync: <City A> / <City B>, <Month>'
Set Body = '<City B> is N hours ahead from <City A>. Avoid: <holiday dates>.'
Send (or in this recording, discard) the draft

instances.values: New York / Berlin, December; Germany holidays; +6h; avoid Dec 25 & 26; to ops@example.com (a San Francisco lookup and an SEC search interrupted it)
London / Sydney, January; Australia holidays; +10h; avoid Jan 1 & 26; to ops@example.com

opportunities.name: SEC EDGAR company filings lookup
opportunities.description: Search EDGAR full-text search by ticker, choose the company from autocomplete, then filter the results by form type (e.g. 10-K) to review recent filings.
steps: Open EDGAR full-text search
Type the ticker into 'Company name, ticker, CIK number or individual's name'
Select the matching company in the autocomplete dropdown
Click SEARCH
In 'Refine search results by', expand Form and click the form type (e.g. 10-K Annual report)
Review the latest filings (filing dates and reporting periods)

instances.values: DDOG (Datadog, Inc., CIK 0001561550), Form 10-K filter carried over
